# @antkit/react

> Declarative React components on Radix primitives and Tailwind v4 tokens.
> 68 components, source-shipped and tree-shakeable. No theme object,
> no CSS preprocessor, no generated class cascade.

- Import from the package root; the barrel tree-shakes and deep paths are not public API.
- Colours are tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`), never a raw palette shade.
- The consuming app needs `@import '@antkit/react/styles.css'` in its CSS, after Tailwind.

## General

- [Button](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/button.md): Six variants, five sizes, a loading state and an icon slot at each end.
- [Typography](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/typography.md): Headings, paragraphs and inline text on the @antkit/styles type scale.

## Layout

- [Layout](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/layout.md): Page frame: header, collapsible sider, content and footer.
- [Sidebar](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/sidebar.md): The navigation rail: menu groups, submenus, and an icon-only collapsed mode.
- [Card](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/card.md): A content block with a header, description, body and footer.
- [Separator](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/separator.md): A horizontal or vertical rule between blocks of content.
- [ScrollShadow](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/scroll-shadow.md): A scroll container that fades whichever edge still has content past it.

## Navigation

- [Breadcrumb](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/breadcrumb.md): The trail of ancestors above the current page.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/dropdown-menu.md): A menu off a button: plain items, checkboxes, radios, groups and submenus.
- [CommandMenu](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/command-menu.md): The ⌘K palette: a search box over a list of actions, opened from anywhere.
- [Tabs](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/tabs.md): Switch panels, in a default or underline variant.
- [Steps](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/steps.md): Progress through a multi-step task, horizontally or vertically.

## Data Entry

- [Form](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/form.md): Declarative forms: rules on the field, no schema, no resolver.
- [Input](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/input.md): A single-line field: every HTML type, error state, icons and buttons attached.
- [Textarea](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/textarea.md): A multi-line field that grows with its content and counts characters.
- [InputNumber](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/input-number.md): A number field with steppers, currency formatting and min/max bounds.
- [Label](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/label.md): A label bound to a control — clicking it focuses the control.
- [Select](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/select.md): One component covering every variant: single, multiple, tags, search, groups.
- [AutoComplete](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/auto-complete.md): A free-text field that suggests, but never forces, a value.
- [Cascader](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/cascader.md): Drill through a fixed-depth hierarchy one column at a time.
- [TreeSelect](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/tree-select.md): A select whose list is a tree with checkable branches.
- [Transfer](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/transfer.md): Two columns to move items between — permissions, tags, members.
- [Checkbox](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/checkbox.md): A three-state tick box, indeterminate included.
- [CheckboxGroup](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/checkbox-group.md): Several options sharing one array of values.
- [Radio](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/radio.md): Pick one of several, with an optional line of help under each label.
- [Switch](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/switch.md): An instant on/off, with a loading state for when it calls an API.
- [Segmented](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/segmented.md): A row of buttons picking one value — tighter than Radio.
- [Slider](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/slider.md): One or two handles, with marks and a value tooltip.
- [Rate](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/rate.md): Star rating, with half stars and a character of your choosing.
- [DatePicker](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/date-picker.md): Type into dd/mm/yyyy segments or open the calendar; ranges included.
- [TimePicker](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/time-picker.md): Pick a time by column, 12h or 24h, ranges included.
- [Dropzone](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/dropzone.md): A drop area for files, with type, size and count limits.
- [RichTextEditor](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/rich-text-editor.md): A formatting editor with images and tables — load it lazily.

## Data Display

- [Table](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/table.md): The data grid: sorting, row selection, fixed and resizable columns, expandable rows, pagination.
- [Pagination](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/pagination.md): Page numbers, with a size changer, a jump-to box and a simple mode.
- [Descriptions](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/descriptions.md): Label–value pairs for a detail page.
- [Statistic](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/statistic.md): A headline number with a prefix, suffix and trend.
- [Tag](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/tag.md): A coloured chip — closable, or toggled like a checkbox.
- [Badge](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/badge.md): A small status label in eight prebuilt tones.
- [CountBadge](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/count-badge.md): A dot or count pinned to the corner of something else.
- [Status](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/status.md): A status dot with a label and an optional pulse.
- [Avatar](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/avatar.md): A profile image with initials to fall back on.
- [Image](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/image.md): An image with a placeholder, an error fallback and a zoom viewer.
- [ImageZoom](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/image-zoom.md): Zoom an image in place on click.
- [Comparison](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/comparison.md): Drag a handle to compare a before and after image.
- [Calendar](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/calendar.md): A calendar mounted straight into the page, for a date or a range.
- [Timeline](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/timeline.md): A timeline where each item’s status colours its dot and rail.
- [Tree](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/tree.md): A hierarchy with branch-wide checking, connector lines and icons.
- [Collapsible](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/collapsible.md): Open and close a block of content.
- [Kanban](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/kanban.md): Columns of cards, dragged within and between columns.
- [List](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/list.md): Grouped rows, dragged vertically between groups.
- [Gantt](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/gantt.md): A schedule by day, week or month, with markers and zoom.
- [Carousel](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/carousel.md): Slides that snap, with dots, arrows, autoplay and a fade effect.
- [Marquee](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/marquee.md): A looping strip of content that pauses on hover.
- [Empty](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/empty.md): The empty state for tables, lists and searches.
- [Tooltip](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/tooltip.md): A short hint on hover, in twelve placements.
- [Popover](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/popover.md): A card anchored to an element, controls included.

## Feedback

- [Alert](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/alert.md): An inline notice in four states — closable, with room for actions.
- [Message](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/message.md): A slim notice at the top of the screen, called imperatively.
- [Notification](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/notification.md): A card in the corner of the screen with a title, body and actions.
- [Toast](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/toast.md): Sonner’s toast, already wired to the kit’s tokens and theme.
- [Modal](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/modal.md): A dialog declared in JSX or called imperatively, turning into a sheet on narrow screens.
- [Sheet](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/sheet.md): A panel sliding in from an edge of the screen.
- [Popconfirm](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/popconfirm.md): A confirmation asked right next to the button just pressed.
- [Progress](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/progress.md): A bar or ring, with success and error states.
- [Spinner](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/spinner.md): A spinner for buttons and for covering a block while it loads.
- [Skeleton](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/skeleton.md): Pulsing grey blocks holding the layout while data loads.
- [Result](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/c/result.md): A result page for success and for 403 / 404 / 500.

## Optional

- [Everything, inlined](https://zocheck.github.io/antkit/llms-full.txt): every doc block in one file.
